name: unsafe fn forward_unchecked (start : Self , count : usize) -> Self
rule: Calling `Step::forward_unchecked(start, count)` must not overflow the range of values supported by `Self` when taking the successor of `start` `count` times; such overflow is undefined behavior.
api: trait Step  : Clone + PartialOrd + Sized { unsafe fn forward_unchecked (start : Self , count : usize) -> Self }
expression: Cannot express this requirement in the supplied DSL: opaque `Self` has no modeled successor operation or supported-value bounds.
